tool_input.command:
cat > /tmp/changelog.yaml <<'EOF'
title: Changelog
sections:
  - id: releases
    items:
      - title: "0.3.0"
        sections:
          - id: changes
            items:
              - title: added
                set:
                  notes: |
                    <<- Sample validation: every sample is admitted or rejected in one place (`validateSample`), checking series name shape, a finite numeric value, and a non-negative integer epoch-millisecond timestamp, so everything downstream can assume a well-formed `Sample`.
                    - Injectable clock and env-read config: `Clock`/`SystemClock`/`FixedClock` keep time a dependency instead of a global read, and `loadConfig` builds a `Config` (window width, per-series sample cap, retention) from the environment, failing loudly on a present-but-unusable value rather than silently falling back.
                    - Bounded ingest queue and wire-line parsing: `parseSample` turns a `"<series> <value> [<at>]"` wire line into a `Sample`, and `IngestQueue` buffers incoming samples up to a fixed capacity, dropping the oldest under sustained overflow so a stalled drain never grows without bound.
                    - In-memory per-series sample store: `MemoryStore` keeps one timestamp-sorted bucket per series, trimming each bucket to a configured maximum and supporting ranged reads, series listing, and retention-based pruning.
                    - Aligned window rollups and summaries: `rollup`/`windowsFor` bucket a series' samples into fixed-width, boundary-aligned windows (omitting empty windows rather than reporting them as zero), and `summarize`/`formatSummary` collapse a window series into a single human- and wire-readable summary.
                    - Router and service wiring: a transport-agnostic `Router` dispatches `POST /samples`, `GET /series`, and `GET /summary/:series` against the store, and `createService` wires config, clock, store, queue, and router together behind one `tick()` that drains ingest and prunes expired samples.
                    >>
EOF
jigc doc author changelog --from-file /tmp/changelog.yaml --task record-a-changelog-entry --format json 2>&1
